description_expanded: Gulf Escape - Vacation Rental House with Private Pool in Seacrest Beach Favorite Features: - Large Screened-in Dual-Entry Private Pool - Less than 1-Minute Walk to Beach - Split Living Spaces featuring Two Kitchens and Living Rooms - 4 Bikes included - 2 Sets of Backpack Beach Chairs included More about Gulf Escape: Welcome to Gulf Escape, where sun, sand, and relaxation await! Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach on 30A, this bright and inviting retreat is perfect for multi-family getaways, or any large gathering. With a huge screened-in private pool, two fully equipped kitchens, and the beach just steps from your front door, you’ll have everything you need for an unforgettable vacation. Originally a duplex, this hidden gem is now a seamless coastal retreat that still offers flexibility for larger groups. Each side features its own kitchen, living room, and laundry area, with a connecting door that can be closed for extra privacy. The coastal-chic design, bright whites, and custom woodwork add character and warmth, creating a space that feels both stylish and comfortable. With four bedrooms and two bathrooms, Gulf Escape comfortably sleeps up to 16 guests. Each side of the home features a king bedroom and a full/full bunk room, with additional sleeping space available on the two sleeper sofas in the living areas. Every bedroom overlooks the shimmering pool, and access to the patio is conveniently located through the bunk rooms. Step outside to the spacious pool area, where there’s plenty of room to relax, play, and soak up the Florida sunshine. Fire up the grill for a cookout, lounge poolside with a drink in hand, or take a quick stroll to the beach for a sunset walk. Plus, with complimentary bikes included, exploring 30A’s charming communities, shops, and restaurants is effortless. Whether you're planning a fun-filled family vacation or a laid-back retreat with friends, Gulf Escape offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Book your stay today and start making unforgettable beach memories!   Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: Full over Full Bunk with Trundle & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: Full over Full Bunk with Trundle & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Additional Arrangements: Sleeper Sofa
